evidence.Time Horizon / Target Date: Q1 2026 project-opposition data; lender practices reported 2026-08-10

evidence.Constraint / Bottleneck: Permitting; community opposition; noise; water and electricity use; cancellation risk
evidence.Source Title: Lenders scrutinize US data center financing as community opposition builds
evidence.Supporting Excerpt (≤20 words): In Q1 2026 alone, 75 projects totaling $130 billion faced opposition.
evidence.Notes: Constraint evidence spans cloud and AI data centers; the $130 billion figure should not be interpreted as AI-only investment or as cancelled capacity.
